name: Knowledge {OS}
tagline: Turn scattered information into a retrievable knowledge base.

commands.name: /knowledge ingest <source>
commands.summary: Register, screen and chunk a source with its provenance.

commands.name: /knowledge index
commands.summary: Build or rebuild the index from registered sources, then re-score retrieval.

commands.name: /knowledge ask <question>
commands.summary: Answer with claims that each cite a span, or abstain honestly.

commands.name: /knowledge pack <purpose>
commands.summary: Build a scoped retrieval pack for another OS, stating what was withheld.

commands.name: /knowledge trace <claim>
commands.summary: Follow a claim back through chunk, source and span to the original document.

commands.name: /knowledge gaps
commands.summary: Report the questions the corpus cannot answer, ranked and routed to their owner.

commands.name: /knowledge stale
commands.summary: Report passages past their review date or superseded, with their owner.

requires_human_approval_for: ingesting a source whose licence or confidentiality is unclear
indexing content from a quarantined or unattributed source
widening a retrieval scope across a project boundary
deleting a source rather than marking it superseded
publishing a gap report that names individuals as the origin of missing material
exporting the corpus or a substantial part of it
